about: News feeds and headline / filing rules (bullet, dated). 'india' feeds fill the News tab, 'global' the World tab. Tone and impact are keyword rules (copied from the legacy app on 13 Nov 2026), shown as a hint only; an AI reading of headlines comes with Tanu's AI (later). A feed URL must pass the market-data URL guard (no 'fund', 'order', 'margin'... in the path).
